name: Marketech International Corp.
summary: Marketech International Corp., manufactures, sells, imports, and trades in a range of integrated circuits, semiconductors, electrical and computer equipment and materials, chemicals, gas, spare parts, and components in Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company is involved in factory affairs and mechatronic systems, including clean rooms, automatic supply system of gas and chemicals, monitoring systems, turn-key, and hook-up project services, and other factory systems and electromechanical systems; and designs and manufactures customized equipment.
